entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Actions
entities.Description: List   of   all   actions   that   are   possible   across   all   AI   Models

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Actions
entities.Description: Table   to   store   the   relationship   between   AI   agents   and   actions .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Artifact   Types
entities.Description: Junction   table   linking   AI   Agents   to   the   artifact   types   they   can   produce .  An   agent   can   produce   zero   to   many   artifact   types .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Categories
entities.Description: Hierarchical   organizational   grouping   for   AI   agents .  Categories   form   a   tree   via   the   ParentID   self - referencing   foreign   key   and   can   carry   inherited   assignment   strategies .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Co   Agents
entities.Description: Agent - to - agent   affinity   registry .  Today :  OPT - IN   co - agent   pairings  —  which   underlying   agents  ( or   whole   agent   types )  a   Realtime - type   co - agent   can   front   in   live   sessions .  A   co - agent   with   NO   rows   is   universal  ( fronts   any   single   agent   supplied   at   runtime  —  the   zero - config   default );  rows   restrict   the   co - agent   to   a   prebuilt   target   list .  The   Type   column   reserves   future   relationship   natures  ( Peer / Delegate / Fallback / Reviewer / Observer ).  Distinct   from   AIAgentRelationship ,  which   wires   agent - to - SUB - AGENT   invocation  ( mappings ,  message   modes );  this   table   is   peer   affinity   with   no   invocation   config .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Configurations
entities.Description: Defines   semantic   configuration   presets   for   agents ,  allowing   users   to   select   between   different   AI   model   configurations  ( e . g .,  Fast ,  Balanced ,  High   Quality )  when   executing   an   agent .  Each   preset   maps   to   an   AI   Configuration   which   controls   model   selection   across   all   prompts .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Credentials
entities.Description: Credentials   an   agent   carries   into   its   harness   sandbox ,  injected   as   environment   variables   at   session   creation .  Custody   of   the   secret   itself   stays   in   Credential / CredentialEngine  -  this   table   records   only   the   GRANT   EDGE ,  in   the   same   reviewable   style   as   AIAgentAction .  Distinct   from   AICredentialBinding ,  which   is   inference - selection   plumbing   for   AIPromptRunner   failover   when   MJ   itself   executes   a   prompt .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Data   Sources
entities.Description: Defines   data   sources   that   should   be   preloaded   into   the   data   parameter   before   agent   execution .  Supports   both   RunView   and   RunQuery   sources   with   configurable   caching .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Examples
entities.Description: Stores   example   input / output   pairs   for   AI   agents   to   learn   from   successful   interactions .  Examples   are   always   agent - specific   and   support   optional   user / company   scoping   for   personalized   examples .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Harnesses
entities.Description: Registry   of   external   agent   harnesses   this   installation   can   launch   as   the   reasoning   substrate   for   an   MJ   agent  ( Claude   Code ,  Codex   CLI ,  OpenCode ,  Pi ,  Cline ).  A   row   makes   a   harness   AVAILABLE ;  an   agent   opts   in   by   naming   it   in   AIAgent . TypeConfiguration .  Empty   table  =  no   agent   can   run   on   a   harness ,  which   is   the   pre - migration   behaviour .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Learning   Cycles
entities.Description: Tracks   the   learning   cycles   for   AI   Agents   where   the   Agent   does   offline   reasoning ,  reflection ,  learning ,  and   updates   metadata .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Modalities
entities.Description: Agent - level   modality   configuration .  Allows   agents   to   restrict   or   customize   modality   settings   beyond   what   the   model   supports .  Absence   of   a   record   means   the   agent   uses   model   defaults  ( Text   in / out   assumed   if   no   records   exist ).

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Models
entities.Description: Table   to   store   the   relationship   between   AI   agents   and   AI   models .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Note   Types
entities.Description: Defines   categories   and   types   for   AI   agent   notes ,  enabling   classification   and   organization   of   agent - generated   observations ,  recommendations ,  and   learnings .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Notes
entities.Description: Stores   notes ,  observations ,  and   learnings   for   AI   agents   with   multi - dimensional   scoping  ( Agent ,  User ,  company ).  Scoping   is   determined   by   which   FK   fields   are   populated :  all   NULL  =  global ,  AgentID   only  =  agent - specific ,  UserID   only  =  user - specific   across   all   agents ,  etc .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Permissions
entities.Description: Defines   access   control   permissions   for   AI   agents   using   an   ACL  ( Access   Control   List )  model .  Permissions   can   be   granted   to   individual   users   or   roles .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Personas
entities.Description: Configures   which   personas   an   AI   agent   is   permitted   to   wear ,  their   preference   order ,  and   which   persona   serves   as   the   agent ' s   default   identity .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Prompts
entities.Description: Links   AI   agents   with   the   prompts   they   use ,  including   execution   order   and   context   handling .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Relationships
entities.Description: Tracks   relationships   between   AI   agents   for   sub - agent   orchestration

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Request   Types
entities.Description: Lookup   table   categorizing   the   types   of   requests   an   agent   can   make   to   a   human  ( e . g .,  Approval ,  Information ,  Choice ,  Review ,  Custom ).

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Requests
entities.Description: Table   to   log   AI   Agent   requests ,  responses ,  and   their   statuses .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Run   Steps
entities.Description: Provides   basic ,  step - by - step   tracking   of   agent   execution .  Each   step   represents   a   discrete   action   within   an   agent   run ,  such   as   prompt   execution ,  tool   usage ,  decision   making ,  or   sub - agent   coordination .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Runs
entities.Description: Tracks   individual   execution   runs   of   AI   agents ,  including   hierarchical   sub - agent   runs .  Provides   basic   logging ,  state   persistence ,  and   resource   tracking   for   agent   executions .  Supports   pause / resume   functionality   through   state   serialization .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Search   Scopes
entities.Description: Many - to - many   between   agents   and   search   scopes ,  with   phase   and   scheduling   control .  Drives   both   pre - execution   RAG   and   agent - invoked   scoped   search .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Session   Bridge   Participants
MJ :  AI   Agent   Step   Paths
entities.Description: Defines   paths  ( edges )  between   steps   in   a   flow - based   AI   agent   execution   graph

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Steps
entities.Description: Defines   individual   steps  ( nodes )  in   a   flow - based   AI   agent   execution   graph

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agent   Types
entities.Description: Defines   types   of   AI   agents   with   their   system   prompts   and   behavioral   characteristics .  Each   agent   type   represents   a   category   of   agents   that   share   common   system - level   instructions   and   capabilities .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Agents
entities.Description: Table   to   store   information   about   AI   agents .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Architectures
entities.Description: Master   table   of   AI   model   architectures  ( Transformer ,  Diffusion ,  MoE ,  etc .)  for   model   catalog   enrichment   and   eval   reporting .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Configuration   Params
entities.Description: Stores   configuration   parameters   that   can   be   referenced   by   prompts   and   used   to   control   execution   behavior .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Configurations
entities.Description: Stores   configurations   for   AI   prompt   execution   environments   and   settings .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Credential   Bindings
entities.Description: Junction   table   that   binds   credentials   to   AI   entities  ( Vendors ,  ModelVendors ,  PromptModels ).  Decouples   credential   assignments   from   core   AI   entities   to   prevent   MJ   updates   from   overwriting   customer   configurations .  Supports   priority - based   failover   with   multiple   credentials   per   binding   level .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Modalities
entities.Description: Master   list   of   AI   content   modalities  ( Text ,  Image ,  Audio ,  Video ,  etc .)  that   models   can   accept   as   input   or   produce   as   output .  New   modalities   can   be   added   via   INSERT   without   schema   changes .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Actions
entities.Description: Tracks   the   actions   supported   by   each   AI   Model

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Architectures
entities.Description: Junction   table   linking   AI   models   to   their   underlying   architectures .  Supports   multiple   architectures   per   model   with   ranking .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Costs
entities.Description: Stores   historical   and   current   pricing   information   for   AI   models   across   different   vendors ,  with   optional   temporal   tracking   and   support   for   different   processing   types

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Modalities
entities.Description: Junction   table   linking   AI   models   to   their   supported   input   and   output   modalities   with   model - specific   configuration .  Used   to   extend   beyond   the   default   modalities   inherited   from   AIModelType .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Personas
entities.Description: Specifies   per - model   persona   availability   overrides   where   a   model ' s   supported   personas   differ   from   its   vendor ' s   default   catalog .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Price   Types
entities.Description: Defines   the   different   types   of   pricing   metrics   used   by   AI   model   vendors  ( e . g .,  Tokens ,  Minutes ,  Characters ,  API   Calls )

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Price   Unit   Types
entities.Description: Defines   the   unit   scales   used   for   pricing  ( e . g .,  Per   1M   Tokens ,  Per   1K   Tokens ,  Per   Minute ).  Includes   driver   class   for   normalization   calculations

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Types
entities.Description: Types   of   AI   Models

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Model   Vendors
entities.Description: Associates   AI   models   with   vendors   providing   them ,  including   vendor - specific   implementation   details .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Models
entities.Description: Catalog   of   all   AI   Models   configured   in   the   system

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Persona   Vendors
entities.Description: Concrete   vendor   and   modality   binding   for   a   persona ,  mapping   the   abstract   persona   to   a   provider - specific   wire   asset   identifier  ( voice   ID   or   avatar   ID ).

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Personas
entities.Description: Abstract ,  provider - agnostic   presentational   identity  ( voice   and / or   visual   appearance )  that   AI   agents   can   assume   when   interacting   with   users .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Prompt   Categories
entities.Description: Categories   for   organizing   AI   prompts   in   a   hierarchical   structure .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Prompt   Models
entities.Description: Associates   AI   prompts   with   specific   models   and   configurations ,  including   execution   details .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Prompt   Runs
entities.Description: Tracks   AI   prompt   executions   including   timings ,  inputs ,  outputs ,  and   performance   metrics .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Prompt   Types
entities.Description: Types   of   AI   prompts   such   as   Chat ,  Text - to - Image ,  Text - to - Video ,  etc .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Prompts
entities.Description: Stores   AI   prompts ,  including   references   to   categories ,  types ,  and   templates .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Result   Cache
entities.Description: Stores   cached   results   of   AI   prompts ,  including   multiple   runs   for   history   and   tracking   purposes .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Skill   Search   Scopes
entities.Description: Search   Scopes   an   AI   Skill   may   reach   when   activated ,  honoured   when   AISkill . SearchScopeAccess  = ' Assigned '.  Mirrors   AIAgentSearchScope :  Status   plus   an   optional   StartAt / EndAt   window   time - box   a   grant ,  and   Priority / IsDefault   pick   among   several .  An   empty   table   means   no   skill   grants   any   scope  -  the   pre - migration   behaviour .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Usage   Types
entities.Description: The   base   measure   a   quantity   of   AI   usage   is   expressed   in  —  Tokens ,  Seconds ,  Characters   or   Images .  Referenced   by   AIModelPriceUnitType  ( what   a   billing   unit   is   a   quantity   of ,  and   therefore   what   every   cost   row   priced   by   it   measures )  and   by   AIPromptRun  ( what   a   recorded   quantity   counts ).  Distinct   from   AIModelPriceUnitType   itself ,  which   names   the   BILLING   unit   and   its   scale :  audio   recorded   in   Seconds   may   be   billed   by   the   Per   Hour   unit   type .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Vendor   Type   Definitions
entities.Description: Defines   the   possible   types   of   AI   vendors ,  such   as   Model   Developer   or   Inference   Provider .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Vendor   Types
entities.Description: Associates   vendors   with   their   types  ( Model   Developer ,  Inference   Provider )  and   tracks   the   status   of   each   role .

entities.Name: MJ :  AI   Vendors
entities.Description: Stores   information   about   AI   vendors   providing   models   and / or   inference   services .

entities.Name: MJ :  API   Application   Scopes
entities.Description: Defines   the   scope   ceiling   for   each   application   with   pattern - based   rules .  Controls   which   scopes   and   resource   patterns   an   application   can   use ,  regardless   of   what   API   keys   grant .

entities.Name: MJ :  API   Applications
entities.Description: Registry   of   applications   that   can   consume   MemberJunction   APIs .  Each   application   defines   a   scope   ceiling   that   limits   what   API   keys   can   access   when   used   with   that   application .

entities.Name: MJ :  API   Key   Applications
entities.Description: Optional   binding   of   API   keys   to   specific   applications .  If   no   records   exist   for   a   key ,  it   works   with   all   applications .  If   records   exist ,  the   key   only   works   with   those   specific   applications .

entities.Name: MJ :  API   Key   Scopes
entities.Description: Junction   table   linking   API   keys   to   their   assigned   permission   scopes .  Each   key   can   have   multiple   scopes ,  and   scopes   can   be   shared   across   multiple   keys .

entities.Name: MJ :  API   Key   Usage   Logs
entities.Description: Audit   log   tracking   all   API   key   usage   for   analytics ,  debugging ,  and   security   monitoring .  Records   each   request   including   endpoint ,  response   status ,  timing ,  and   client   information .

entities.Name: MJ :  API   Keys
entities.Description: Stores   API   keys   for   programmatic   access   to   MemberJunction   services .  Keys   are   stored   as   SHA - 256   hashes   for   security .  Each   key   is   associated   with   a   user   context   and   can   have   multiple   permission   scopes   assigned .

entities.Name: MJ :  API   Scopes
entities.Description: Defines   reusable   permission   scopes   that   can   be   assigned   to   API   keys .  Scopes   follow   a   hierarchical   naming   convention  ( e . g .,  entities : read ,  agents : execute ,  admin :*)  and   are   grouped   by   category   for   organizational   purposes .

entities.Name: MJ :  Access   Control   Rules
entities.Description: Generic   ACL - style   permission   system   that   can   control   access   to   any   entity   record   in   the   system   with   granular   CRUD   permissions .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Authorizations
entities.Description: Links   actions   to   authorizations ,  one   or   more   of   these   must   be   possessed   by   a   user   in   order   to   execute   the   action .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Categories
entities.Description: Organizes   actions   into   categories ,  including   name ,  description ,  and   optional   parent   category   for   hierarchy .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Context   Types
entities.Description: Lists   possible   contexts   for   action   execution   with   optional   descriptions .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Contexts
entities.Description: Links   actions   to   their   supported   context   types   enabling   a   given   action   to   be   executable   in   more   than   one   context .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Execution   Logs
entities.Description: Tracks   every   execution   of   an   action ,  including   start   and   end   times ,  inputs ,  outputs ,  and   result   codes .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Filters
entities.Description: Defines   filters   that   can   be   evaluated   ahead   of   executing   an   action .  Action   Filters   are   usable   in   any   code   pipeline   you   can   execute   them   with   the   same   context   as   the   action   itself   and   use   the   outcome   to   determine   if   the   action   should   execute   or   not .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Libraries
entities.Description: Tracks   the   list   of   libraries   that   a   given   Action   uses ,  including   a   list   of   classes / functions   for   each   library .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Params
entities.Description: Tracks   the   input   and   output   parameters   for   Actions .

entities.Name: MJ :  Action   Result   Codes
entities.Description: Defines   the   possible   result   codes   for   each   action .

entities.Name: MJ :  Actions
entities.Description: Stores   action   definitions ,  including   prompts ,  generated   code ,  user   comments ,  and   status .

entities.Name: MJ :  Application   Entities
entities.Description: List   of   entities   within   each   application .  An   application   can   have   any   number   of   entities   and   an   entity   can   be   part   of   any   number   of   applications .

entities.Name: MJ :  Application   Roles
entities.Description: Controls   which   roles   can   access   and   administer   specific   applications .  When   no   ApplicationRole   records   exist   for   an   application ,  all   roles   can   access   it  ( open   access ).  When   at   least   one   record   exists ,  only   roles   with   CanAccess = 1   are   permitted .

entities.Name: MJ :  Application   Settings
entities.Description: Stores   configuration   settings   and   preferences   for   applications ,  including   key - value   pairs   for   runtime   parameters   and   user - specific   customizations .

entities.Name: MJ :  Applications
entities.Description: Applications   are   used   to   group   entities   in   the   user   interface   for   ease   of   user   access

entities.Name: MJ :  Archive   Configuration   Entities
entities.Description: Per - entity   configuration   within   an   archive   pipeline .  Allows   overriding   the   parent   configuration ' s   defaults   for   mode ,  retention ,  batch   size ,  and   filtering   on   a   per - entity   basis .

entities.Name: MJ :  Archive   Configurations
entities.Description: Top - level   configuration   for   an   archive   pipeline .  Defines   the   storage   target ,  default   retention   policy ,  archive   format ,  and   operational   mode   for   archiving   entity   records .

entities.Name: MJ :  Archive   Run   Details
entities.Description: Per - record   detail   for   each   archive   run .  Tracks   the   outcome ,  storage   location ,  and   error   information   for   each   individual   record   processed .

entities.Name: MJ :  Archive   Runs
entities.Description: Tracks   each   execution   of   an   archive   configuration ,  including   timing ,  aggregate   statistics ,  and   overall   status .

entities.Name: MJ :  Artifact   Permissions
entities.Description: Manages   user   permissions   for   artifacts   with   granular   access   control  ( Read ,  Edit ,  Delete ,  Share )

entities.Name: MJ :  Artifact   Types
entities.Description: Defines   the   types   of   artifacts   that   can   be   created   within   conversations

entities.Name: MJ :  Artifact   Uses
entities.Description: Audit   trail   of   artifact   usage   for   security   and   analytics .  Tracks   each   time   an   artifact   is   viewed ,  opened ,  shared ,  saved ,  or   exported   by   users .

entities.Name: MJ :  Artifact   Version   Attributes
entities.Description: Stores   extracted   attribute   values   from   artifact   content   based   on   ArtifactType   ExtractRules .  Prevents   re - running   extraction   logic   on   every   access .

entities.Name: MJ :  Artifact   Versions
entities.Description: Version   history   for   artifacts ,  tracking   all   changes   over   time

entities.Name: MJ :  Artifacts
entities.Description: Independent   content   items  ( code ,  documents ,  charts )  that   can   be   linked   to   multiple   conversations   and   collections .  Supports   versioning   and   sharing .

entities.Name: MJ :  Audit   Log   Types
entities.Description: Defines   the   types   of   events   that   can   be   recorded   in   the   audit   log ,  enabling   categorization   and   filtering   of   system   activities .

entities.Name: MJ :  Audit   Logs
entities.Description: Tracks   system   events   and   user   actions   for   security ,  compliance ,  and   debugging   purposes ,  providing   a   complete   audit   trail .  Any   application   can   write   entries   to   this   entity .

entities.Name: MJ :  Authentication   Providers
entities.Description: Metadata   catalog   of   authentication   providers .  Each   row   defines   one   provider  ( Auth0 ,  Okta ,  MSAL ,  Cognito ,  Google ,  WorkOS ,  or   any   third - party   driver )  whose   implementation   is   resolved   at   runtime   from   DriverClass   via   MJGlobal . Supersedes   the   hard - wired   mj . config . cjs   authProviders   array ,  which   remains   a   back - compat   fallback   when   this   table   is   empty .

entities.Name: MJ :  Authorization   Roles
entities.Description: Links   authorizations   to   roles ,  defining   which   permissions   are   granted   to   users   assigned   to   specific   roles   in   the   system .

entities.Name: MJ :  Authorizations
entities.Description: Stores   the   fundamental   permissions   and   access   rights   that   can   be   granted   to   users   and   roles   throughout   the   system .

entities.Name: MJ :  Communication   Providers

entities.Name: MJ :  Experiment   Sessions

The   execution   phase   runs   iterations   in   WAVES   through   Record   Set   Processing  ( bounded   concurrency ,  budget ,  pause / resume ,  audit ),  with   the   adaptive   prune / what - next   logic   above   it .

entities.Description: Metadata   catalog   of   identity   claim   types .  Each   row   defines   a   claim   kind   whose   lifecycle  ( create ,  claim ,  revoke ,  expire )  is   executed   by   a   BaseIdentityClaimDriver   plugin   resolved   at   runtime   from   DriverClass   via   ClassFactory .

entities.Name: MJ :  Identity   Claims
entities.Description: Records   of   pending ,  claimed ,  or   expired   identity   claims   addressed   to   an   email   address .  Facilitates   cross - system   entitlement   claiming ,  account   linking ,  and   invite   verification .

entities.Name: MJ :  Instance   Configurations
entities.Description: Instance - level   feature   toggles   and   configuration .  Controls   which   features   are   enabled   per   MJ   Explorer   deployment .

entities.Name: MJ :  Integration   Object   Fields
entities.Description: Describes   a   field   on   an   integration   object ,  mirroring   EntityField   column   patterns   for   type   compatibility

entities.Name: MJ :  Integration   Objects
entities.Description: Describes   an   external   object   or   endpoint   exposed   by   an   integration  ( e . g .,  Members ,  Events ,  Invoices )

entities.Name: MJ :  Integration   Source   Types
entities.Description: Defines   categories   of   integration   sources   such   as   SaaS   API ,  Relational   Database ,  or   File   Feed .

entities.Name: MJ :  Integration   URL   Formats
entities.Description: Used   to   generate   web   links   for   end   users   to   easily   access   resources   in   a   source   system .  URL   Formats   support   templating   to   inject   various   field   values   at   run - time   to   take   a   user   directly   to   a   resource   in   a   source   system .

entities.Name: MJ :  Integrations
entities.Description: Catalog   of   all   integrations   that   have   been   configured   in   the   system .

entities.Name: MJ :  Knowledge   Hub   Saved   Searches
entities.Description: User - saved   search   queries   for   the   Knowledge   Hub .  Stores   query   text ,  active   filters  ( JSON ),  and   score   thresholds   so   searches   can   be   recalled   or   run   on   a   schedule .

entities.Name: MJ :  Libraries
entities.Description: Stores   information   about   the   available   libraries ,  including   a   list   of   classes / functions ,  type   definitions ,  and   sample   code .  You   can   add   additional   custom   libraries   here   to   make   them   avaialable   to   code   generation   features   within   the   system .

entities.Name: MJ :  Library   Items
entities.Description: Table   to   store   individual   library   items

entities.Name: MJ :  List   Categories
entities.Description: Groups   lists   into   categories   for   organization   and   navigation ,  supporting   hierarchical   categorization   of   user - created   lists .

entities.Name: MJ :  List   Details
entities.Description: Tracks   the   records   within   each   list .

entities.Name: MJ :  List   Invitations
entities.Description: Tracks   pending   invitations   for   users   to   access   lists ,  including   external   users   via   email .

entities.Name: MJ :  List   Shares
entities.Description: Manages   user   access   and   permissions   for   shared   lists .

entities.Name: MJ :  Lists
entities.Description: Static   lists   are   useful   for   controlling   a   set   of   data   for   a   given   entity .  These   can   be   used   programatically   for   applications   like   logging   and   tracking   long - running   tasks   and   also   by   end   users   for   tracking   any   particular   list   of   records   they   want   to   directly   control   the   set .

entities.Name: MJ :  MCP   Tool   Favorites
entities.Description: Per - user   favorite   marker   for   an   MCP   Server   Tool .  Each   row   indicates   the   user   has   starred   the   referenced   tool   for   quick   access   in   the   MCP   Dashboard   Tools   tab   and   in   the   Test   Tool   dialog   picker .  Combined   with   UserID   forms   a   unique   pair   so   a   user   cannot   favorite   the   same   tool   twice .

entities.Name: MJ :  ML   Algorithm   Use   Case   Rankings
entities.Description: Codifies   how   well   each   algorithm   fits   each   use - case   scenario ,  so   both   the   model - development   agent   and   a   non - expert   human   get   guided ,  rationale - bearing   defaults   instead   of   guessing .  One   row   per  ( algorithm ,  use   case )  pair .

entities.Name: MJ :  ML   Algorithm   Use   Cases
entities.Description: A   curated ,  decision - relevant   scenario   used   to   guide   algorithm   choice  —  NOT   a   business   label  ( churn / renewal / attendee - return   are   all   the   same  " binary   classification "  shape ,  so   they   do   not   differentiate   algorithms ).  Joined   to   MLAlgorithm   via   MLAlgorithmUseCaseRanking .  EXAMPLES : " Binary   classification  ( yes / no )", " Regression  ( predict   a   number )", " Interpretability   required ", " Minimal   tuning  ( business - user )", " Large / wide   dataset  ( speed )", " Embedding / LLM - feature - heavy ", " Small   dataset ".

entities.Name: MJ :  ML   Algorithms
entities.Description: Curated ,  fixed   catalog   of   machine - learning   algorithms   a   Training   Pipeline   can   use .  Opinionated   by   design  ( a   small   set   of   well - understood   algorithms );  the   differentiation   is   in   the   data / features ,  not   algorithm   innovation .  Each   row   declares   the   algorithm ' s   supported   problem   types ,  its   hyperparameter   schema ,  and   the   Python - sidecar   driver   key   that   executes   it .  EXAMPLE : " Gradient   Boosting  ( XGBoost )"  with   DriverClass  " xgboost ".

entities.Name: MJ :  ML   Model   Scoring   Bindings
entities.Description: Binds   an   MLModel   to   where   it   scores ,  so   staleness   can   be   detected   and   retraining   driven  ( maintenance ).  The   scoring   itself   runs   as   a   Record   Process  ( the   new   ML   inference   work   type );  the   binding   records   the   target   entity / column   written   and   the   scoring   mode .  MaterializedResultID   is   a   forward - compatible   SOFT   reference   to   MJ :  Materialized   Results  ( PR  # 2770 ),  not   yet   a   FK   because   that   table   is   not   merged .

entities.Name: MJ :  ML   Models
entities.Description: An   immutable ,  versioned   trained   predictive   model   produced   by   a   training   run  —  distinct   from   MJ :  AI   Models  ( the   catalog   of   off - the - shelf   foundation   models   we   CALL ).  A   model   is   never   mutated   in   place ;  retraining   produces   a   new   MLModel .  The   serialized   artifact   lives   in   MJStorage  ( MJ :  Files )  and   the   FITTED   preprocessing   parameters   travel   WITH   the   model   so   inference   applies   the   exact   transforms   learned   at   training   time  ( prevents   train / serve   skew ).  Inference   runs   via   the   Python   sidecar .

entities.Name: MJ :  ML   Training   Pipelines
entities.Description: A   declarative   definition   of   how   to   build   a   predictive   model :  what   to   predict  ( target ),  over   which   entity ' s   records ,  using   which   algorithm ,  assembled   from   which   sources   via   which   feature   steps ,  validated   how .  Saving   a   pipeline   saves   intent ,  not   results  —  each   successful   training   run   of   it   produces   an   immutable   MLModel .  EXAMPLE : " Member   Renewal   Predictor "  predicts   Member . Renewed   using   XGBoost   from   tenure / engagement   features   plus   a   member - summary   embedding ,  with   a   point - in - time   as - of   strategy   and   a   locked   holdout .

entities.Name: MJ :  ML   Training   Runs
entities.Description: The   ML - specific   detail   of   a   training   attempt  —  the   leaf   that   hangs   off   a   generic   ExperimentSessionIteration   when   part   of   an   agent - driven   search ,  OR   stands   alone  ( ExperimentSessionIterationID   NULL )  for   a   one - off   manual   train .  Captures   the   exact   feature   set ,  algorithm ,  hyperparameters ,  validation   results ,  and   the   model   produced  ( ResultingModelID   is   nullable :  a   run   may   be   pruned / failed   and   produce   no   model ).  The   generic   search - level   accounting  ( leaderboard   Score ,  rationale ,  the   driving   agent   run )  lives   on   the   parent   iteration ;  this   row   keeps   the   ML   execution   detail .

entities.Name: MJ :  Magic   Link   Invite   Allowed   Domains
entities.Description: An   external   host  ( origin )  where   this   invite   may   be   embedded   in   an   IFRAME .  Enforced   server - side   via   Content - Security - Policy   frame - ancestors   plus   Origin / Referer   checks   on   embed   responses .  Multiple   rows  =  multiple   allowed   hosts .

entities.Name: MJ :  Magic   Link   Invite   Allowed   Paths
entities.Description: An   Explorer   FE   path  ( after   the   base   URL )  this   link   is   confined   to   in   the   UI .  This   is   UX   confinement   only  —  the   real   authorization   boundary   is   server - side   entity / resource   permissions .  Multiple   rows  =  multiple   allowed   paths .

entities.Name: MJ :  Magic   Link   Invite   Applications
entities.Description: Join   row   granting   a   magic - link   invite   access   to   one   Application .  An   invite   may   eventually   carry   several ;  today   create / redeem   write   exactly   one  ( mirroring   MagicLinkInvite . ApplicationID )  while   multi - scope   enforcement   is   being   designed .

entities.Name: MJ :  Magic   Link   Invite   Roles
entities.Description: Join   row   granting   a   magic - link   invite   a   Role .  An   invite   may   eventually   carry   several ;  today   create / redeem   write   exactly   one  ( mirroring   MagicLinkInvite . RoleID )  while   multi - scope   enforcement   is   being   designed .

entities.Name: MJ :  Magic   Link   Invites
entities.Description: A   shareable ,  single - use ,  app - scoped   magic - link   invite   for   an   external   user .  Bound   to   one   Application   and   one   restricted   Role ;  redeeming   it   provisions / links   a   user   with   that   scope   and   mints   a   short - lived   MJ - issued   JWT .  The   raw   token   is   never   stored  —  only   its   SHA - 256   hash .

entities.Name: MJ :  Magic   Link   Redemptions
entities.Description: One   row   per   magic - link   redemption   ATTEMPT  ( success   or   failure ).  Provides   per - use   redemption   history   and   forensic   visibility   into   token   scanning / brute - force .  Distinct   from   MagicLinkInvite ,  which   keeps   only   an   aggregate   UseCount  +  last   ConsumedAt .

entities.Name: MJ :  O   Auth   Auth   Server   Metadata   Caches
entities.Description: Caches   OAuth   2 . 0   Authorization   Server   Metadata  ( RFC   8414 )  to   reduce   discovery   requests .

entities.Name: MJ :  O   Auth   Authorization   States
entities.Description: Tracks   in - progress   OAuth   authorization   flows   with   PKCE   data   for   security .

entities.Name: MJ :  O   Auth   Client   Registrations
entities.Description: Stores   OAuth   Dynamic   Client   Registration  ( DCR )  results   per   RFC   7591 .

entities.Name: MJ :  O   Auth   Tokens
entities.Description: Stores   OAuth   token   metadata   for   MCP   server   connections .  Actual   tokens   are   stored   via   CredentialEngine   for   consistent   encryption   and   audit   logging .

entities.Name: MJ :  Open   App   Dependencies
entities.Description: Inter - app   dependency   relationships   between   installed   Open   Apps

entities.Name: MJ :  Open   App   Install   Histories
entities.Description: Audit   trail   of   every   install ,  upgrade ,  and   removal   for   Open   Apps

entities.Name: MJ :  Open   Apps
entities.Description: Tracks   all   MJ   Open   Apps   installed   in   this   instance

entities.Name: MJ :  Output   Delivery   Types
entities.Description: Defines   methods   for   delivering   generated   outputs   such   as   email ,  file   storage ,  API   endpoints ,  or   messaging   platforms .

entities.Name: MJ :  Output   Format   Types
entities.Description: Specifies   available   output   formats   for   generated   content   including   PDF ,  Excel ,  CSV ,  JSON ,  and   custom   formats .

entities.Name: MJ :  Permission   Domains
entities.Description: Catalog   of   registered   permission   subsystems .  Each   row   describes   one   permission   provider ;  the   PermissionEngine   uses   ProviderClassName   as   the   ClassFactory   key   to   instantiate   providers   at   startup .  Enables   unified   permission   queries   across   all   subsystems .

entities.Name: MJ :  Process   Run   Details
entities.Description: Per - record   result   within   a   Process   Run :  powers   audit ,  resume  ( skip   already - done   records ),  and   the   run - viewer   UX .  One   row   per   processed   record .  EXAMPLE :  customer   CUST - 00417  ->  Succeeded   with   ResultPayload  {" satisfaction ":" High "," sentiment ": 0 . 82 }  and   a   link   to   its   AI   Agent   Run ;  customer   CUST - 00418  ->  Failed   with   ErrorMessage  " Model   timeout ".

entities.Name: MJ :  Process   Runs
entities.Description: Source - agnostic   header   for   one   execution   of   any   set - processing   job .  Deliberately   generic :  a   Record   Process   run   sets   RecordProcessID ,  but   legacy / engine - driven   jobs  ( e . g .,  a   geocoding   sweep   or   vector   sync )  keep   their   own   source   tables   and   still   record   a   run   here   with   RecordProcessID  =  NULL ,  giving   every   batch   a   uniform   audit  +  resume   trail .  EXAMPLE :  the   Saturday   2am   run   of  " Weekly   Customer   Health   Summary "  over   1 , 284   active   customers  ( RecordProcessID   set ,  TriggeredBy = Schedule );  or   a   nightly   geocoding   sweep  ( RecordProcessID   NULL ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Projects
entities.Description: Container   for   grouping   related   conversations   around   a   common   topic ,  client ,  or   initiative .  Supports   nesting   for   sub - projects .

entities.Name: MJ :  Public   Links
entities.Description: Shareable   links   for   external   access   to   artifacts   and   other   resources .  Supports   password   protection   and   expiration .

entities.Name: MJ :  Queries
entities.Description: Catalog   of   stored   queries .  This   is   useful   for   any   arbitrary   query   that   is   known   to   be   performant   and   correct   and   can   be   reused .  Queries   can   be   viewed / run   by   a   user ,  used   programatically   via   RunQuery ,  and   also   used   by   AI   systems   for   improved   reliability   instead   of   dynamically   generated   SQL .  Queries   can   also   improve   security   since   they   store   the   SQL   instead   of   using   dynamic   SQL .

entities.Name: MJ :  Query   Categories
entities.Description: Organizes   saved   queries   into   categories   for   discovery   and   management ,  supporting   folder - like   organization   of   queries .

entities.Name: MJ :  Query   Dependencies
entities.Description: Tracks   which   queries   reference   other   queries   via   composition   syntax .  Auto - populated   by   the   query   save   pipeline .

entities.Name: MJ :  Query   Entities
entities.Description: Tracks   which   entities   are   involved   in   a   given   query .  The   Queries   table   stores   SQL   and   descriptions   for   stored   queries   that   can   be   executed   and   serve   as   examples   for   AI .

entities.Name: MJ :  Query   Fields
entities.Description: Stores   field - level   metadata   for   queries   including   display   names ,  data   types ,  and   formatting   rules   for   result   presentation .

entities.Name: MJ :  Query   Parameters
entities.Description: Stores   parameter   definitions   for   parameterized   queries   that   use   Nunjucks   templates .  Each   parameter   represents   a   dynamic   value   that   can   be   passed   when   executing   the   query .  Parameters   are   automatically   extracted   from   the   query   template   by   the   QueryEntityServer   using   LLM   analysis ,  or   can   be   manually   defined .  The   combination   of   parameter   metadata   and   validation   filters   creates   a   self - documenting ,  type - safe   query   execution   system .

entities.Name: MJ :  Query   Permissions
entities.Description: Controls   access   to   queries   by   defining   which   users   and   roles   can   run   specific   queries .

entities.Name: MJ :  Queue   Tasks
entities.Description: Manages   asynchronous   tasks   in   processing   queues ,  tracking   status ,  priority ,  and   execution   details   for   background   operations .

entities.Name: MJ :  Queue   Types
entities.Description: Defines   different   types   of   processing   queues   with   specific   behaviors ,  priorities ,  and   processing   rules   for   task   management .

entities.Name: MJ :  Queues
entities.Description: Queues   can   be   used   to   async   execute   long   running   tasks

entities.Name: MJ :  RSU   Pending   Works
entities.Description: Durable   queue   of   Runtime   Schema   Update  ( RSU )  pending   setup   work   that   must   survive   a   server   restart  —  replaces   the   former  . rsu_pending   directory   of   delete - on - read   JSON   files .  A   row   is   inserted   when   post - restart   work   is   registered ,  marked   Completed   only   AFTER   the   work   succeeds ,  and   marked   Failed   with   ErrorMessage   on   error  ( never   deleted   on   read ),  so   stranded   work   older   than   N   minutes   is   queryable   instead   of   silently   lost .

entities.Name: MJ :  Recommendation   Items
entities.Description: Table   to   store   individual   recommendation   items   that   are   the   right   side   of   the   recommendation   which   we   track   in   the   DestinationEntityID / DestinationEntityRecordID

entities.Name: MJ :  Recommendation   Providers
entities.Description: Recommendation   providers   details

entities.Name: MJ :  Recommendation   Runs
entities.Description: Recommendation   runs   log   each   time   a   provider   is   requested   to   provide   recommendations

entities.Name: MJ :  Recommendations
entities.Description: Recommendation   headers   that   store   the   left   side   of   the   recommendation   which   we   track   in   the   SourceEntityID / SourceEntityRecordID

entities.Name: MJ :  Record   Change   Replay   Runs
entities.Description: Table   to   track   the   runs   of   replaying   external   record   changes

entities.Name: MJ :  Record   Changes
entities.Description: For   entities   that   have   TrackRecordChanges = 1 ,  Record   Changes   will   store   the   history   of   all   changes   made   within   the   system .  For   integrations   you   can   directly   add   values   here   if   you   have   inbound   signals   indicating   records   were   changed   in   a   source   system .  This   entity   only   automatically   captures   Record   Changes   if   they   were   made   within   the   system .

entities.Name: MJ :  Record   Geo   Codes
entities.Description: Polymorphic   table   storing   persisted   geocoding   results   for   any   MJ   entity   record .  Each   row   maps   an   entity   record  +  location   type   to   a   lat / lng   coordinate ,  with   optional   country / state   references   for   choropleth   grouping .  Supports   multi - location   entities   via   LocationType   discriminator .

entities.Name: MJ :  Record   Links
entities.Description: Generic   linking   table   that   can   connect   any   two   records   in   the   system ,  providing   a   flexible   relationship   management   system .

entities.Name: MJ :  Record   Merge   Deletion   Logs
entities.Description: Tracks   records   deleted   during   merge   operations ,  maintaining   an   audit   trail   of   data   consolidation   activities .

entities.Name: MJ :  Record   Merge   Logs
entities.Description: Records   the   history   of   record   merge   operations   including   source   records ,  target   records ,  and   merge   rules   applied .

entities.Name: MJ :  Record   Process   Categories
entities.Description: Hierarchical   folder   for   organizing   Record   Processes   in   the   UI .  Example : " Customer   Lifecycle "  with   a   child   category  " Retention ".

entities.Name: MJ :  Record   Process   Watermarks
entities.Description: Per - record   change - detection   watermark   backing   WatermarkStrategy = Checksum .  Stores   the   last   content   hash   a   Record   Process   processed   for   a   given   record   so   unchanged   records   are   skipped   on   the   next   run .  Only   used   by   Checksum   mode ;  UpdatedAt   mode   compares   __mj_UpdatedAt   and   stores   nothing   here .

entities.Name: MJ :  Record   Processes
entities.Description: A   declarative ,  reusable   job   definition   that   binds   three   axes   of   a   business   process :  WORK  ( an   Action   or   an   Agent )  x   SCOPE  ( a   single   record ,  a   User   View ,  a   List ,  or   an   ad - hoc   Filter )  x   TRIGGER  ( on - change   save   hooks ,  a   cron   schedule ,  and / or   on   demand ).  One   row   is   one   configured   process ;  each   execution   of   it   produces   a   Process   Run   with   per - record   Process   Run   Details .  EXAMPLE :  a  " Weekly   Customer   Health   Summary "  row   runs   the  " Customer   Summarizer "  agent   over   the  " Active   Customers "  view   every   Saturday   2am ,  also   whenever   a   customer ' s   NPS / support   fields   change ,  and   on   demand ;  for   each   customer   it   infers  { satisfaction ,  sentiment ,  personalityStyle ,  summary }  and   writes   satisfaction / sentiment   back   onto   the   Customer   plus   a   summary   into   a   Customer   Insights   child   row ,  skipping   customers   unchanged   since   the   last   run .

entities.Name: MJ :  Remote   Operation   Categories
entities.Description: Hierarchical   folder   for   organizing   Remote   Operations   in   the   UI .  Example : " Record   Processes "  with   a   child   category  " Control "  holding   RunNow  /  Pause  /  Cancel .

entities.Name: MJ :  Remote   Operations
entities.Description: Definition   of   a   typed ,  provider - routed   server   operation   invoked   identically   from   the   client  ( marshalled   over   GraphQL )  and   the   server  ( dispatched   in - process ) -  the   typed   peer   of   BaseEntity  ( CRUD )  and   RunView  ( set   reads )  for   arbitrary   capabilities .  Input / output   types   are   declared   here   and   emitted   by   CodeGen   into   a   typed   base   class ;  the   body   may   be   hand - written   or   AI - authored   from   Description .  EXAMPLE : " RecordProcess . RunNow " ( ExecutionMode = LongRunning )  takes  { recordProcessID }  and   returns  { processRunID },  authorized   by   the   recordprocess : execute   scope   plus   the   caller ' s   entity   permissions .

entities.Name: MJ :  Resource   Links
entities.Description: Table   to   track   user   links   to   shared   resources   such   as   views ,  dashboards ,  etc .

entities.Name: MJ :  Resource   Permissions
entities.Description: Table   for   managing   sharing   of   resources   to   users   or   roles   with   time   constraints   and   permission   levels

entities.Name: MJ :  Resource   Types
entities.Description: Tracks   types   of   system   resources   such   as   records ,  dashboards ,  and   reports .

entities.Name: MJ :  Roles
entities.Description: Roles   are   used   for   security   administration   and   can   have   zero   to   many   Users   as   members

entities.Name: MJ :  Row   Level   Security   Filters
entities.Description: Defines   data   access   rules   that   filter   records   based   on   user   context ,  implementing   fine - grained   security   at   the   row   level .

entities.Name: MJ :  Scheduled   Job   Runs
entities.Description: Records   execution   history   for   scheduled   jobs .  Provides   uniform   tracking   across   all   job   types .  Each   record   represents   one   execution   attempt   of   a   scheduled   job .

entities.Name: MJ :  Scheduled   Job   Types
entities.Description: Defines   types   of   schedulable   jobs   and   their   plugin   implementations .  Each   job   type   represents   a   different   kind   of   work   that   can   be   scheduled  ( e . g .,  Agents ,  Actions ,  Reports ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Scheduled   Jobs
entities.Description: Defines   schedules   for   automated   job   execution   across   all   schedulable   types .  Each   record   represents   a   scheduled   job   with   its   cron   expression ,  configuration ,  and   execution   tracking .

entities.Name: MJ :  Schema   Info
entities.Description: Tracks   the   schemas   in   the   system   and   the   ID   ranges   that   are   valid   for   entities   within   each   schema .

entities.Name: MJ :  Scoped   Prompt   Configs
entities.Description: A   scope - aware   override   of   an   AIPrompt ' s   RUN   SETTINGS  ( model / vendor ,  AI   configuration ,  sampling   knobs ,  response   format ,  effort   level ).  The   run - settings   sibling   of   ScopedPromptPart .  Narrowed   by   a   polymorphic   scope  ( PrimaryScopeEntity / Record  +  SecondaryScopes ).  Resolved   by   a   cached   engine   via   a   specificity   cascade   per   PromptID  —  the   most - specific   in - scope   row   wins   as   a   whole   row  ( tie - broken   by   Priority );  each   non - null   column   overrides   the   prompt   default ,  a   NULL   column   inherits   it .  Runtime - explicit   overrides   on   the   agent   run   still   win .  Lets   any   MJ   app   tune   model / generation   behavior   per   scope   by   editing   rows ,  not   code .

entities.Name: MJ :  Scoped   Prompt   Parts
entities.Description: A   scope - aware ,  role - tagged   fragment   of   prompt   text   attached   to   an   AIPrompt .  Optionally   narrowed   by   a   polymorphic   scope  ( PrimaryScopeEntity / Record  +  SecondaryScopes  —  the   same   scope   the   agent   runtime   carries   for   memory ).  Resolved   by   a   cached   engine   via   a   specificity   cascade   per  ( PromptID ,  Name ) —  more - specific   scope   wins  —  then   assembled   additively  ( by   Sort )  into   a   role - faithful   chat   message   list .  Lets   any   MJ   app   control   prompt   behavior   per   scope   by   editing   rows ,  not   code .

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Execution   Logs
entities.Description: One   row   per   SearchEngine . search   invocation .  Populated   by   SearchEngine ' s   post - fusion   logging   hook  ( Phase   3 . 2 ).  Read   by   the   Knowledge   Hub   Search   Analytics   dashboard  ( Phase   3 . 3 )  and   the   per - scope   tuning   CSV   export  ( Phase   3 . 4 ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Scope   Entities
entities.Description: Controls   which   entities   participate   in   entity   and   full - text   search   within   a   scope ,  with   optional   per - entity   filter   and   user - search - string   overrides .

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Scope   External   Indexes
entities.Description: Scoped   external / provider - owned   indexes .  Generic  —  covers   vector   stores  ( Pinecone ,  Qdrant ,  PGVector )  and   text / hybrid   engines  ( Elasticsearch ,  Typesense ,  Azure   AI   Search ,  OpenSearch ).  A   single   scope   can   mix   types ;  each   row   is   consumed   only   by   the   provider   matching   its   IndexType .

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Scope   Permissions
entities.Description: Per - user   or   per - role   permission   grant   on   a   SearchScope .  Exactly   one   of   UserID   or   RoleID   is   set   on   each   row ;  the   other   is   NULL .  PermissionLevel   is   one   of   None ,  Read ,  Search ,  Manage .  Combined   with   AIAgent . SearchScopeAccess   for   agent - side   fallbacks   via   the   SearchScopePermissionResolver .

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Scope   Providers
entities.Description: Controls   which   SearchProviders   participate   in   a   given   SearchScope .  Each   row   enables   one   provider   within   one   scope ,  with   optional   overrides .

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Scope   Storage   Accounts
entities.Description: Controls   which   file   storage   accounts / folders   participate   in   a   scope .

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Scope   Test   Queries
entities.Description: Canonical   test   queries   owned   by   a   SearchScope .  Used   by   scope   authors   to   validate   tuning   changes  —  re - run   a   saved   query   after   swapping   the   reranker   or   adjusting   fusion   weights   and   compare   results   to   the   prior   run .

entities.Name: MJ :  Search   Scopes
entities.Description: A   named ,  reusable   boundary   defining   WHICH   content   participates   in   a   search  ( providers ,  external   indexes ,  entities ,  storage   accounts ).  Combined   with   a   runtime   SearchContext ,  it   enables   multi - tenant ,  permission - aware ,  agent - friendly   retrieval .  See   plans / search - scopes - rag - plus . md .

entities.Name: MJ :  Skills
entities.Description: A   hierarchical   list   of   possible   skills   that   are   linked   to   Employees   and   can   also   be   linked   to   any   other   entity

entities.Name: MJ :  State   Provinces
entities.Description: Reference   table   for   states ,  provinces ,  and   first - level   administrative   divisions .  Linked   to   Country   via   FK .  Seeded   with  ~ 5 , 000   records   with   ISO   3166 - 2   codes ,  centroids ,  and   optional   boundary   GeoJSON .

entities.Name: MJ :  Tag   Audit   Logs
entities.Description: Immutable   audit   trail   for   all   tag   taxonomy   changes .  Each   row   records   a   single   action   with   before / after   details   in   JSON .

entities.Name: MJ :  Tag   Co   Occurrences
entities.Description: Materialized   co - occurrence   counts   for   tag   pairs .  Records   how   many   content   items   share   both   tags .  Used   for   taxonomy   health   analysis ,  merge   suggestions ,  and   cross - entity   intelligence .  Recomputed   periodically   by   the   pipeline .

entities.Name: MJ :  Tag   Scopes
entities.Description: Polymorphic   junction   binding   a   Tag   to   one   or   more  ( Entity ,  Record )  scope   rows .  A   Tag   with   one   or   more   TagScope   rows   is   only   visible   inside   those   scopes ;  a   Tag   with   no   rows   AND   IsGlobal = 1   is   visible   everywhere .  Mirrors   the   shape   of   TaggedItem .

entities.Name: MJ :  Tag   Suggestions
entities.Description: Human - in - the - loop   review   queue   for   tag   changes   the   autotagger   could   not   commit   autonomously :  ambiguous   matches ,  governance - blocked   auto - grows ,  low - usage   deprecation   candidates ,  and   merge   candidates   from   co - occurrence   analysis .

entities.Name: MJ :  Tag   Synonyms
entities.Description: Alternate   names   that   should   resolve   to   a   Tag   during   autotagging .  Consulted   before   exact / fuzzy / semantic   match   tiers   in   TagEngine . ResolveTag .

entities.Name: MJ :  Tagged   Items
entities.Description: Tracks   the   links   between   any   record   in   any   entity   with   Tags

entities.Name: MJ :  Tags
entities.Description: Tags   are   used   to   arbitrarily   associate   any   record   in   any   entity   with   addtional   information .

entities.Name: MJ :  Task   Dependencies
entities.Description: Defines   dependencies   between   tasks   to   create   a   directed   acyclic   graph  ( DAG )  for   workflow   orchestration

entities.Name: MJ :  Task   Types
entities.Description: Categorization   system   for   different   types   of   tasks   that   can   be   created   and   managed   within   the   system

entities.Name: MJ :  Tasks
entities.Description: Core   task   management   entity   supporting   multi - agent   and   multi - human   collaboration   with   dependency   tracking

entities.Name: MJ :  Template   Categories
entities.Description: Template   categories   for   organizing   templates

entities.Name: MJ :  Template   Content   Types
entities.Description: Template   content   types   for   categorizing   content   within   templates

entities.Name: MJ :  Template   Contents
entities.Description: Template   content   for   different   versions   of   a   template   for   purposes   like   HTML / Text / etc

entities.Name: MJ :  Template   Params
entities.Description: Parameters   allowed   for   use   inside   the   template

entities.Name: MJ :  Templates
entities.Description: Templates   are   used   for   dynamic   expansion   of   a   static   template   with   data   from   a   given   context .  Templates   can   be   used   to   create   documents ,  messages   and   anything   else   that   requires   dynamic   document   creation   merging   together   static   text ,  data   and   lightweight   logic

entities.Name: MJ :  Test   Rubrics
entities.Description: Reusable   evaluation   criteria  ( rubrics )  for   consistent   scoring   across   tests .  Rubrics   define   structured   evaluation   dimensions   and   can   include   LLM   prompts   for   automated   judgment .  Particularly   useful   for   LLM - as - judge   patterns   where   consistent   evaluation   criteria   are   critical .

entities.Name: MJ :  Test   Run   Feedbacks
entities.Description: Human - in - the - loop   feedback   on   test   run   results .  Allows   human   reviewers   to   validate ,  correct ,  or   override   automated   test   results .  Essential   for   training   and   improving   automated   evaluation   criteria .

entities.Name: MJ :  Test   Runs
entities.Description: Execution   instance   of   a   single   test .  Captures   inputs ,  outputs ,  results ,  and   links   to   the   target   being   tested  ( e . g .,  Agent   Run ).  Can   be   part   of   a   suite   run   or   standalone .  The   TargetLogID   links   to   type - specific   execution   logs  ( AgentRun ,  WorkflowRun ,  etc .)  which   contain   the   detailed   trace   information .

entities.Name: MJ :  Test   Suite   Runs
entities.Description: Execution   instance   of   a   test   suite .  Captures   who   ran   it ,  when ,  in   what   environment ,  and   aggregates   results   from   all   tests   in   the   suite .  Supports   versioning   via   GitCommit   and   AgentVersion   fields   to   track   system   state   during   execution .

entities.Name: MJ :  Test   Suite   Tests
entities.Description: Junction   table   linking   tests   to   test   suites .  Allows   many - to - many   relationship   where   a   test   can   belong   to   multiple   suites   and   a   suite   can   contain   multiple   tests .  Includes   sequence   for   execution   order   and   configuration   overrides   specific   to   this   suite - test   pairing .

entities.Name: MJ :  Test   Suites
entities.Description: Hierarchical   organization   of   tests   into   suites .  Test   suites   can   contain   other   suites  ( via   ParentID )  and   tests  ( via   TestSuiteTest   junction   table ).  Suites   provide   logical   grouping   for   running   batches   of   related   tests .

entities.Name: MJ :  Test   Types
entities.Description: Defines   test   type   drivers   that   can   be   dynamically   instantiated   via   MJGlobal . Instance . ClassFactory . CreateInstance ( BaseTestDriver ,  DriverClass ).  Each   test   type   represents   a   different   category   of   testing  ( e . g .,  Agent   Evals ,  Workflow   Tests ,  Code   Generation   Tests ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Tests
entities.Description: Individual   test   definitions .  Each   test   has   a   specific   type  ( via   TypeID )  which   determines   how   it   executes .  Tests   store   their   inputs ,  expected   outcomes ,  and   configuration   as   JSON ,  allowing   flexibility   for   different   test   types   while   maintaining   a   common   schema .

entities.Name: MJ :  Themes
entities.Description: A   named   brand   theme .  Stores  ~ 8   brand   seeds  ( color   hue   anchors ,  neutral   character ,  vibrancy ,  shape ,  depth ,  type ,  viz   palette )  as   JSON ;  the   full  -- mj -*  design - token   contract   is   derived   from   the   seeds   at   load .  A   theme   is   a   brand  —  light / dark   is   the   user ' s   mode   layered   under   it ,  so   a   theme   carries   no   per - mode   values .

entities.Name: MJ :  User   Application   Entities
entities.Description: Links   users   to   specific   entities   within   applications ,  managing   entity - level   personalization .

entities.Name: MJ :  User   Applications
entities.Description: Tracks   which   applications   users   have   configured   to   display .

entities.Name: MJ :  User   Favorites
entities.Description: Records   that   each   user   can   mark   as   a   favorite   for   easy   access

entities.Name: MJ :  User   Notification   Preferences
entities.Description: Per - user   preferences   for   each   notification   type  ( delivery   method   overrides )

entities.Name: MJ :  User   Notification   Types
entities.Description: Defines   categories   of   notifications   with   delivery   configuration   and   template   associations

entities.Name: MJ :  User   Notifications
entities.Description: Manages   notifications   sent   to   users   including   alerts ,  messages ,  and   system   updates   with   read   status   and   priority .

entities.Name: MJ :  User   Record   Logs
entities.Description: Tracks   user   interactions   with   specific   records ,  maintaining   an   audit   trail   of   views   or   other   operations .  Changes   are   managed   separately   in   the   Record   Changes   entity .

entities.Name: MJ :  User   Roles
entities.Description: Associates   users   with   roles   in   the   system ,  managing   role - based   access   control   and   permission   inheritance .

entities.Name: MJ :  User   Settings
entities.Description: Generic   key - value   store   for   per - user   settings .  Allows   any   application   or   feature   to   persist   user   preferences .

entities.Name: MJ :  User   View   Categories
entities.Description: Organizes   user - created   views   into   categories   for   personal   organization   and   sharing   within   teams .

entities.Name: MJ :  User   View   Run   Details
entities.Description: Tracks   the   set   of   records   that   were   included   in   each   run   of   a   given   user   view .

entities.Name: MJ :  User   View   Runs
entities.Description: User   Views   can   be   logged   when   run   to   capture   the   date   and   user   that   ran   the   view   as   well   as   the   output   results .

entities.Name: MJ :  User   Views
entities.Description: Views   are   sets   of   records   within   a   given   entity   defined   by   filtering   rules .  Views   can   be   used   programatically   to   retrieve   dynamic   sets   of   data   and   in   user   interfaces   like   MJ   Explorer   for   end - user   consumption .

entities.Name: MJ :  Users
entities.Description: A   list   of   all   users   who   have   or   had   access   to   the   system

entities.Name: MJ :  Vector   Databases
entities.Description: Configures   connections   to   vector   database   systems   for   AI   embeddings ,  similarity   search ,  and   semantic   operations .

entities.Name: MJ :  Vector   Indexes
entities.Description: Defines   vector   indexes   within   a   given   Vector   Database .

entities.Name: MJ :  Version   Installations
entities.Description: Records   installation   history   of   system   versions ,  tracking   deployments ,  rollbacks ,  and   version - specific   configurations .

entities.Name: MJ :  Version   Label   Items
entities.Description: Links   a   Version   Label   to   the   specific   RecordChange   snapshot   for   each   record   captured   by   that   label .  Denormalizes   EntityID   and   RecordID   for   efficient   querying .

entities.Name: MJ :  Version   Label   Restores
entities.Description: Audit   trail   for   restore   operations   performed   against   version   labels .  Tracks   progress ,  success / failure   counts ,  and   links   to   the   safety - net   pre - restore   label .

entities.Name: MJ :  Version   Labels
entities.Description: A   named   point - in - time   bookmark   into   the   RecordChange   history ,  used   for   versioning ,  diffing ,  and   restoration .

entities.Name: MJ :  View   Types
entities.Description: Registry   of   available   view   types  ( Grid ,  Cards ,  Timeline ,  Map ,  Cluster ,  Tag   Cloud , ...)  for   the   entity - viewer   plugin   system .  Each   row   binds   a   logical   view   to   its   renderer   and  ( optionally )  its   configuration   prop - sheet ,  so   adding   a   new   way   to   visualize   records   is   a   metadata   row   plus   a   registered   driver   class  —  no   change   to   the   host   viewer .  Whether   a   given   view   type   is   offered   for   a   given   entity   is   decided   at   runtime   by   the   driver ' s   availability   predicate  ( e . g .  Timeline   needs   a   date   field ,  Map   needs   geocoding ,  Cluster   needs   an   Entity   Document   with   vectors ).

entities.Name: MJ :  Web   Search   Providers
entities.Description: Registry   of   external   web   search   vendors   available   to  @ memberjunction / web - search - engine .  Each   row   configures   one   driver :  whether   it   is   active ,  its   position   in   the   failover   order ,  and   where   its   credential   lives .  Provider   capabilities  ( answer   synthesis ,  domain   filtering ,  freshness )  are   declared   by   the   driver   class ,  not   stored   here .

entities.Name: MJ :  Workspace   Items
entities.Description: Tracks   the   resources   that   are   active   within   a   given   worksapce

entities.Name: MJ :  Workspaces
entities.Description: A   user   can   have   one   or   more   workspaces

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Item   Uses
entities.Description: A   record   that   a   member   opened ,  uploaded ,  or   promoted   an   item .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Share   Notices
entities.Description: A   notice   that   an   item   in   this   space   was   shared   with   a   member .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Anchors
entities.Description: A   record   a   space   is   about  ( D26 :  a   space   may   have   several ).  The   primary   anchor   is   the   one   EnsureSpaceForRecord   finds   a   space   by ;  one   per   space ,  and   one   space   per  ( type ,  record )  as   primary .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Grants
entities.Description: Something   the   app ,  a   space   type   or   a   space   offers   in   its   spaces  ( D27 ' s   seven   kinds ):  an   agent ,  an   action ,  a   query ,  a   view ,  a   dashboard ,  a   component   or   a   knowledge   source ,  with   the   band   that   may   use   it ,  bindings   from   the   space   to   the   target ' s   parameters ,  and   an   agent ' s   narrowed   settings .  Replaces   SpaceAgent ,  SpaceAgentSkill   and   SpaceKnowledgeSource .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Items
entities.Description: An   item   in   exactly   one   space :  EntityID  +  RecordID ,  plus   Team   or   Shared .  Unique   on  ( EntityID ,  RecordID )  so   an   item   cannot   have   two   parents .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Member   Pins
entities.Description: Something   a   member   keeps   at   the   top   of   a   space  ( B22 ):  a   record   of   the   space  ( an   item ,  a   note ,  a   task )  or   one   of   the   space ' s   grants  ( a   view ,  a   dashboard ,  a   component ).  The   member ' s   own ;  Home   lists   pins   from   the   spaces   they   still   reach .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Members
entities.Description: One   roster   row   per   user   per   space .  Staff   and   outsiders   are   both   MJ   users .  Status   Active   is   the   row   the   membership   filter   accepts .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Notes
entities.Description: A   light   note   in   a   space  ( B21 ):  the   space ' s   own   row   on   a   band ,  not   a   library   item ,  so   the   move - and - promote   rules   do   not   apply   and   it   needs   no   ItemUse .  Private   notes   are   the   author ' s   alone .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Role   Types
entities.Description: What   a   space   member   is   allowed   to   do .  The   engine   reads   Level   and   the   BIT   flags .  It   never   compares   Code   or   Name .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Type   Status
entities.Description: A   status   a   space   type   offers   its   spaces :  Active ,  Paused ,  Closed   and   Archived   ship   for   every   type ;  a   type   may   add   its   own .  A   space   is   in   exactly   one   of   its   type ' s   statuses  ( Space . StatusID )  and   may   only   choose   among   them .  The   attributes   say   what   a   space   in   the   status   allows ;  the   type ' s   driver   may   still   refuse   a   change .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Space   Types
entities.Description: Kind   of   space :  vocabulary ,  which   panels   are   on ,  retention   and   agent   defaults ,  and   how   outsiders   join .  Behavior   lives   in   these   columns ,  not   in   code   branched   on   the   name .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Collaboration :  Spaces
entities.Description: The   container .  Permission   boundary   and   agent   retrieval   boundary ,  as   a   tree :  one   root   per   relationship ,  sub - spaces   for   the   work   inside   it .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activities
entities.Description: One   interaction   that   happened   between   people ,  about   records .  Timeline   card  —  not   a   blob   store ,  not   a   task ,  not   field - level   audit .  Duration   is   derived   from   StartedAt / EndedAt .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Files
entities.Description: Join   from   an   Activity   to   an   MJ   File .  Kind   Body   is   the   full   MIME / HTML  ( at   most   one   per   activity );  Attachment   and   Ics   are   extras .  Deleting   the   activity   drops   the   join ,  not   the   File .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Links
entities.Description: Attaches   an   Activity   to   a   resolved   MJ   record  ( EntityID  +  RecordID )  or   an   unresolved   identity  ( email / phone / external   user )  the   matcher   has   not   stamped   yet .  Role   says   whether   the   link   is   Regarding ,  a   participant ,  or   an   email / meeting   mailbox   role .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Connection   Rule   Sets
entities.Description: Binds   a   rule   set   to   a   connection ,  ordered .  Many - to - many   so   a   mailbox   composes   an   org - wide   baseline ,  a   team   overlay ,  and   anything   specific   to   itself  —  rather   than   owning   one   private   copy   of   everything .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Connections
entities.Description: A   mailbox ,  calendar ,  or   other   provider   connection   that   writes   Activities .  CredentialsRef   is   an   MJ   Credentials   engine   key  —  never   a   secret   at   rest .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Exclusions
entities.Description: Never - ingest   list ,  by   identity :  an   email   address ,  a   phone   number ,  a   social   handle ,  or   a   whole   domain .  Rows   rather   than   a   delimited   string   because   an   exclusion   that   cannot   be   queried   cannot   be   audited ,  and   this   is   precisely   what   a   legal   hold ,  an   HR   matter   or   an   opt - out   has   to   be   able   to   prove .  Scoped   to   a   rule   set ,  or   global   when   ActivitySyncRuleSetID   is   null .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Extensions
entities.Description: Registration   of   an   in - process   enrichment   plugin   that   runs   inside   the   Activity   write   transaction .  Common   ships   this   table ;  each   consumer   app   ships   its   own   rows ,  so   a   downstream   app   adds   links  ( a   deal ,  a   campaign )  without   Common   knowing   it   exists .  Extensions   ENRICH  —  they   never   veto   an   activity ,  because   qualification   has   already   run   and   capture   must   not   depend   on   which   apps   are   installed .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Provider   Types
entities.Description: A   kind   of   activity   source  ( Microsoft365 ,  Gmail ,  Twilio   SMS ,  LinkedIn , …).  Provider   identity   is   DATA ,  not   a   CHECK   constraint ,  so   a   new   source   is   a   new   plugin   package   plus   a   metadata   row  —  never   a   migration   to   Common .  Also   carries   the   DEFAULTS   an   operator   should   set   once   per   provider   rather   than   per   mailbox :  storage ,  encryption   key ,  attachment   cap ,  and   what   an   undecided   qualification   verdict   means .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Rule   Sets
entities.Description: A   NAMED ,  REUSABLE   set   of   rules   bound   to   many   connections .  Rules   used   to   hang   off   a   single   connection ,  so   an   org - wide   prohibition   had   to   be   retyped   for   every   mailbox   and   a   new   mailbox   started   with   none  —  governance   by   copy - paste .  A   rule   set   is   authored   once   and   bound   wherever   it   applies .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Rules
entities.Description: Include / exclude   rule   for   an   ActivitySyncConnection :  type ,  direction ,  date   window ,  attachments ,  plus   a   JSON   Filter  ( folders ,  domains ,  participant - must - match - ContactMethod ).

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Run   Details
entities.Description: The   decision   made   about   ONE   message ,  written   for   every   item   considered   INCLUDING   every   skip  —  which   is   what   makes  " why   did   my   email   not   appear "  answerable .  ExternalID   and   the   decision   are   always   safe   to   keep :  an   opaque   provider   id   and   the   name   of   a   rule ,  not   content .  CapturedContent   is   different   in   kind   and   is   governed   by   the   effective   SkippedContentPolicy .  Give   this   entity   permissions   DISTINCT   from   Activity :  it   can   hold   fragments   of   messages   that   were   deliberately   not   ingested .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Sync   Runs
entities.Description: One   sync   pass   over   one   connection :  what   it   fetched ,  what   it   decided ,  and   whether   it   earned   the   right   to   move   the   watermark .  A   dry   run   is   a   real   row   with   IsDryRun   set  —  it   evaluates   and   reports   without   writing   an   Activity   or   advancing   the   connection .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Activity   Types
entities.Description: Lookup   of   interaction   channels  ( Email ,  Call ,  Meeting ,  Note ,  SMS ,  Chat ).  Hierarchy   is   picker - only ;  direction   lives   on   Activity .  Code   is   the   stable   key  —  sync   and   code   target   Code ,  never   Name .

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Address   Links
entities.Description: Polymorphic   link   table   connecting   Address   records   to   any   entity   record   in   the   system   via   EntityID   and   RecordID

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Address   Types
entities.Description: Categories   of   addresses   such   as   Home ,  Work ,  Mailing ,  Billing

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Addresses
entities.Description: Standalone   physical   address   records   linked   to   entities   via   AddressLink   for   sharing   across   people   and   organizations

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Contact   Methods
entities.Description: Additional   contact   methods   for   people   and   organizations   beyond   the   primary   email   and   phone   fields

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Contact   Types
entities.Description: Categories   of   contact   methods   such   as   Phone ,  Mobile ,  Email ,  LinkedIn ,  Website

entities.Name: MJ_BizApps_Common :  Job   Functions
entities.Description: Business   job   functions  ( Engineering ,  Marketing ,  Sales ,  etc .)  for   categorizing   roles   and   career   paths .
